name: Hooterville Unknowns
description: Hooterville Unknowns is a Chicago street gang active in the late 1970s, connected to the United Neighborhoods alliance. Around 1979, a figure known as 'Tic,' who had previously served as war council for the La Familia Warlords, transitioned to serve as war council for the Hooterville Unknowns.

sources.title: Chicago Warlords Gang - United Neighborhoods | StoneGreasers.com
